query:
Independently research disclosed outside funding events for ONLY the ventures below. Read /workspace/deal_rules.md and /workspace/funders_audit_sample.csv. User needs a funding audit, not licensing or company metadata. Search web freshly (no facts from memory); about 3-6 searches/fetches each, more for many rounds. Include ALL disclosed events: seed, angel, accelerator, series, grants, crowdfunding, token, debt, secondary etc. One row per event with columns exactly key,venture,type,label,date,amount_usd,lead,investors,source_url,confidence. Types from rules, or none_found only after reasonable searches. Date YYYY-MM; blank when month unknown, explain in notes. Amount digits USD, blank undisclosed; avoid unsubstantiated exchange conversion. People 'Full Name (person)', firms usual names, lead excluded from investors, separators ' | '. Each event source must actually name investors or amount. Prefer company/investor/filings/reputable news; fetch sources, don't infer investors across rounds. Acquisition/IPO not ordinary funding; include IPO only if outside capital issued and clear amount. Keep distinct secondary deals; don't duplicate total cumulative amounts as separate rounds. If no funding, none_found row and note search scope; distinguish bootstrapped if sourced. Need one line per venture on searches and uncertainties. Explicitly report which ventures NOT fully researched (reasonable search with none found counts researched; unresolved material event histories count incomplete). Save CSV to /workspace/audit_work/group4.csv and notes JSON to /workspace/audit_work/group4_notes.json, JSON list of objects with key, note, incomplete(boolean), sources(list URLs checked). Save full BibTeX for EVERY used web source using e14c.web.save_citation (load citation-integrity skill). Persist search/fetch evidence in /workspace/audit_work/group4_evidence.json or .md. Do NOT overwrite root .deliverables.json or other groups files. Final answer short with local file paths and incomplete count. You have ~35 min; prioritize full coverage and trustworthy sources. Ventures:
key,venture,universe,category,website,github_orgs
redisson,Redisson,U1,COSS (GitHub core),https://redisson.pro,redisson
supermemoryai,Supermemory,U1,COSS (GitHub core),https://supermemory.com,supermemoryai
TecharoHQ,Techaro,U1,COSS (GitHub core),https://techaro.lol,TecharoHQ
d2lang,Terrastruct,U1,COSS (GitHub core),https://d2lang.com,d2lang
getzep,Zep,U1,COSS (GitHub core),https://www.getzep.com,getzep


If this task asks for a specific answer format, follow it. Write any prose in plain, complete sentences that a scientist outside this project could follow, and explain any labels, task IDs, or abbreviations you use.

Current date: 2026-11-26
answer:
## Files Ready for Analysis

| File | Description | Format | Size |
|---|---|---|---|
| `/workspace/audit_work/group4.csv` | Funding audit: 9 rows across 5 ventures; provisional events explicitly labeled | CSV | 2.5 KB |
| `/workspace/audit_work/group4_notes.json` | Search scope, uncertainties, checked sources, and completeness flags | JSON | 8.8 KB |
| `/workspace/audit_work/group4_evidence.json` | Supporting evidence: 74 searches, 52 fetches, and event adjudications | JSON | 7.1 MB |
| `/workspace/audit_work/group4_sources.bib` | Supporting bibliography: 232 complete source entries | BibTeX | 81.8 KB |
| `/workspace/audit_work/group4_reproduce.py` | Supporting reproduction and optional evidence-refresh script | Python | 2.5 KB |

**Incomplete: 3 of 5 ventures—Supermemory, Terrastruct, and Zep.** All five were researched. Unresolved grant receipt, early financing, and round-linkage questions are documented in the notes.

File provenance and reproduction:
- `/workspace/audit_work/group4.csv`: Manually adjudicated funding events from fetched company, investor, news, and database sources. Dates normalized to month and USD amounts to digits; no currency conversions. Row-level source URLs are included.
- `/workspace/audit_work/group4_notes.json`: Research summaries derived from the checked URLs listed in each object.
- `/workspace/audit_work/group4_evidence.json`: Retains complete search queries, returned URLs/text, fetched pages, and field-level decisions. Retrieval cutoff: **2026-11-26**; no fixed source versions were requested.
- `/workspace/audit_work/group4_sources.bib`: Generated from retained source metadata; every entry was saved using `e14c.web.save_citation`. Its library copy is `/workspace/citations/default_project/cb65c732-d0ce-4369-860f-29e5528ac62b.bib` (81.9 KB).
- `/workspace/audit_work/group4_reproduce.py`: Regenerates audited CSV/notes from the evidence snapshot; `--refresh` repeats the saved queries and fetches for human review.

The required rules and sample files were absent, so canonical rule validation was unavailable; the explicit prompt schema and categories were followed.
